context_packs_creator_xor.name: context_packs_creator_xor
context_packs_creator_xor.value: (creator_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (creator_human_id IS NOT NULL)

correlation_seals_caller_xor.name: correlation_seals_caller_xor
correlation_seals_caller_xor.value: (sealed_by_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (sealed_by_human_id IS NOT NULL)

diaries_creator_xor.name: diaries_creator_xor
diaries_creator_xor.value: (creator_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (creator_human_id IS NOT NULL)

diary_entries_creator_xor.name: diary_entries_creator_xor
diary_entries_creator_xor.value: (creator_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (creator_human_id IS NOT NULL)

groups_creator_xor.name: groups_creator_xor
groups_creator_xor.value: (creator_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (creator_human_id IS NOT NULL)

rendered_packs_creator_xor.name: rendered_packs_creator_xor
rendered_packs_creator_xor.value: (creator_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (creator_human_id IS NOT NULL)

runtime_models_creator_xor.name: runtime_models_creator_xor
runtime_models_creator_xor.value: (team_id IS NULL AND created_by_agent_id IS NULL AND created_by_human_id IS NULL) OR (team_id IS NOT NULL AND ((created_by_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (created_by_human_id IS NOT NULL)))

runtime_policies_creator_xor.name: runtime_policies_creator_xor
runtime_policies_creator_xor.value: (created_by_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (created_by_human_id IS NOT NULL)

runtime_profiles_creator_xor.name: runtime_profiles_creator_xor
runtime_profiles_creator_xor.value: (created_by_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (created_by_human_id IS NOT NULL)

runtime_profiles_temperature_range.name: runtime_profiles_temperature_range
runtime_profiles_temperature_range.value: temperature IS NULL OR (temperature >= 0 AND temperature <= 2)

runtime_profiles_top_p_range.name: runtime_profiles_top_p_range
runtime_profiles_top_p_range.value: top_p IS NULL OR (top_p >= 0 AND top_p <= 1)

runtime_profiles_default_workspace_mode_.name: runtime_profiles_default_workspace_mode_allowed
runtime_profiles_default_workspace_mode_.value: default_workspace_mode IS NULL OR default_workspace_mode = ANY(allowed_workspace_modes)

runtime_sessions_parent_not_self.name: runtime_sessions_parent_not_self
runtime_sessions_parent_not_self.value: parent_session_id IS NULL OR parent_session_id <> id

signing_credential_events_actor_xor.name: signing_credential_events_actor_xor
signing_credential_events_actor_xor.value: (actor_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (actor_human_id IS NOT NULL)

signing_credentials_owner_xor.name: signing_credentials_owner_xor
signing_credentials_owner_xor.value: (owner_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (owner_human_id IS NOT NULL)

signing_requests_delegated_context.name: signing_requests_delegated_context
signing_requests_delegated_context.value: verification_method = 'agent-ed25519' OR (team_id IS NOT NULL AND requested_by IS NOT NULL AND signer_constraint IS NOT NULL)

signing_requests_claimed_state.name: signing_requests_claimed_state
signing_requests_claimed_state.value: status <> 'claimed' OR (claimed_by_human_id IS NOT NULL AND signing_credential_id IS NOT NULL AND challenge IS NOT NULL AND method_state IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL)

signing_requests_rejected_state.name: signing_requests_rejected_state
signing_requests_rejected_state.value: status <> 'rejected' OR (team_id IS NOT NULL AND rejected_at IS NOT NULL)

task_attempts_authority_binding_all_or_n.name: task_attempts_authority_binding_all_or_none
task_attempts_authority_binding_all_or_n.value:
(
        lease_id IS NULL
        AND runtime_profile_id IS NULL
        AND runtime_profile_revision IS NULL
        AND policy_snapshot_hash IS NULL
      ) OR (
        lease_id IS NOT NULL
        AND runtime_profile_id IS NOT NULL
        AND runtime_profile_revision IS NOT NULL
        AND runtime_profile_revision > 0
        AND policy_snapshot_hash IS NOT NULL
        AND claimed_executor_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
      )

tasks_non_terminal_expires_idx.name: tasks_non_terminal_expires_idx
tasks_non_terminal_expires_idx.where: expires_at IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('dispatched', 'running', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')

tasks_terminal_retention_idx.name: tasks_terminal_retention_idx
tasks_terminal_retention_idx.where: completed_at IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')

tasks_proposer_xor.name: tasks_proposer_xor
tasks_proposer_xor.value: (proposed_by_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (proposed_by_human_id IS NOT NULL)

tasks_canceller_xor.name: tasks_canceller_xor
tasks_canceller_xor.value: status <> 'cancelled' OR (cancelled_by_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (cancelled_by_human_id IS NOT NULL)

tasks_cancel_reason_required.name: tasks_cancel_reason_required
tasks_cancel_reason_required.value: status <> 'cancelled' OR cancel_reason IS NOT NULL

team_invites_creator_xor.name: team_invites_creator_xor
team_invites_creator_xor.value: (creator_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (creator_human_id IS NOT NULL)

teams_creator_xor.name: teams_creator_xor
teams_creator_xor.value: (creator_agent_id IS NOT NULL) <> (creator_human_id IS NOT NULL)
